feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 May 2026 5:20am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 26 May 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure continues to cover the area.


##Wind##

Variable 1 to 3, settling North or Northwest 3 or 4 this morning, then occasionally 5 in the west of the area later in afternoon and evening. Then gradually veering East 4 or 5 in all waters tonight, occasionally 6 in south of area.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later today and tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly East 4 or 5 through tomorrow morning and afternoon, occasionally 6 in the south of the area at first. Increasing East or Southeast 5 or 6 during the evening and at first overnight, possibly occasionally 7 in the south and west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
